title: Widow's Bay at night, cliff top empty
prompt:

The same composition as bay-backcloth (a moonlit harbour, a high cliff at the left, the red-and-white lighthouse distant on a headland at the right, fishing boats at anchor) but with NO house on the cliff top: the game stands its own stone house there. Requested final aspect ratio 2560:1440. Opaque full-bleed scene; paint right to every boundary.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark. Precisely preserve supplied harbour composition, moon, lighthouse, cliffs and boats. Remove ONLY the house; replace its footprint with bare grassy clifftop.
